# BrewMenu
> A native macOS menu bar app that turns Homebrew into something you can actually see.

## Pages
- [Homepage](https://brewmenu.vercel.app): Install, features, and screenshots
- [GitHub](https://github.com/dotfn/brewmenu): Source, issues, releases

## Key facts
- Free, open source, MIT licensed
- macOS 15 (Sequoia) and later
- Install: brew install --cask dotfn/tap/brewmenu
